# Lua API

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reference for every namespace exposed under the global `smelt` table. Signatures are derived from the Rust closure's argument tuple and return type, so the LuaCATS-style annotation always matches what mlua actually marshals.

**Coverage:** 58 namespace(s), 225 function(s), 27 class(es), 9 alias(es).

## IDE completion

Stubs land in `runtime/lua/smelt/_meta/` (one file per namespace, plus `_types.lua` for shared records and aliases). Point lua-language-server at that directory — see [`runtime/.luarc.json`](https://github.com/leonardcser/smelt/blob/main/runtime/.luarc.json) for a working config.
